title: introduce-invocation-debounce-meter-and-annotated-trace-insights
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add invocation debounce meter to reduce alert noise; attach token-cost deltas and KV-cache annotations to spans; new dashboard panels and tuned alert rules to suppress duplicate low-signal alerts.
description:
Background & motivation:
Noise from repeated micro-regressions and duplicate alerts has been driving oncall fatigue. Two common patterns we see: (1) brief bursts of token-cost jitter that resolve within seconds and (2) many alerts for the same underlying invocation when downstream logs differ slightly. This PR introduces an invocation-level debounce meter and a compact span annotation format so we can both reduce noise and provide richer, explainable trace context in dashboards and alert runbooks.

What this change does (summary):
- Add an invocation debounce meter (telemetry/metrics) that tracks per-endpoint debounce windows and produces a rolling suppression score used by alerting rules. The meter is configurable by route and priority tier.
- Enrich traces with "annotated trace insights": a compact JSON blob attached to the root span that contains (a) token-cost delta per stage, (b) KV cache hit/miss counts and warmup indicators, (c) model variant id and quantization tag. These are intentionally small to avoid span bloat.
- Update alerting rules to consult debounce score and signature-similarity (sha1 of normalized invocation footprint) to coalesce duplicates and silence flapping alerts for a short window.
- Add three dashboard panels: Debounce heatmap (per-route), Token-regression sparklines (30d baseline vs current), and Trace-insight detail panel that decodes the annotated blob.
- Tests: unit tests for debounce meter math and integration test that exercises annotation flow end-to-end.
- Docs: shorthowto added to docs/observability/debounce.md and updated runbook examples.

Implementation notes (technical details):
- telemetry/debounce_meter.go: lightweight in-memory sliding-window counter keyed by (tenant, route, priority). Uses exponential decay to keep low memory footprint. Exposes metrics: rrd_debounce_score, rrd_debounce_evict_count, rrd_debounce_sample_count.
- tracing/span_enricher.go: new helper that computes a compact insight blob (base64 gzipped JSON, schema v1) and attaches as span attribute span.attr.trace_insights. The blob schema keeps fields flat: token_delta, kv_hits, kv_misses, variant, quant. The code uses existing span sampling hooks to avoid extra RPCs.
- alerts/token_alerts.yaml: small updates adding conditions: debounce_score < 0.6 OR signature_changed = true triggers immediately, otherwise apply suppress_for: 90s for duplicates. Added similarity pre-processor that computes normalized fingerprint.
- dashboards/debounce_insights.json: Grafana panel definitions (3 panels) and a templated variable for tenant/route.

Testing & CI:
- Unit tests: pass (local and CI).
- Integration tests: flaky on first run in CI due to timing; increased timeouts and re-ran — subsequent run passed.
- Lint/staticcheck: pass.
- Load smoke: lightweight benchmark run against staging showed no measurable qps regression.

Review conversation (high level):
- Luca Moretti: Requested that debounce default window be shorter for hosted tier and added a config flag to override; asked for clarity on metric cardinality.
- Maya Chen (author): Added per-route bucketing and exponential decay to keep cardinality bounded; updated docs with guidance.
- Priya Nair: Flagged potential privacy risk of attaching model variant ids to spans; requested quantization tag be optional behind flag.
- Maya Chen: Made quant tag optional and added masking in telemetry for private deployments; added unit test.
- Evan Brooks: Asked for stronger test coverage for duplicate coalescing. Added integration test that simulates bursty duplicates.
- Final: All reviewers approved; Kept one follow-up TODO to add retention-tier aware debounce thresholds.

Metrics & observability impacts:
- New metrics: rrd_debounce_score{tenant,route,priority}, rrd_debounce_sample_count, span.insight_attached{true,false}.
- Expected short-term reduction in duplicate alerts: estimated 20-35% for noisy routes based on staging replay.

Backward compatibility & rollout strategy:
- Feature gated by config: observability.enable_debounce=true (default true for hosted). For Private installs, operator can disable.
- Rollout: staged canary across 5% traffic with annotation sampling at 10% to validate size/cost impact before 100% enablement.

Follow-ups (tracked in Linear):
- ENG-2210: Add retention-aware debounce presets for Dedicated & Private tenants.
- ENG-2235: Expose trace-insight JSON in Console trace UI with safe decoding and size limits.

Merge notes:
- Merge method: squash
- Merge outcome: merged after approvals and green CI.

If you want a short diff excerpt for review, I can include the core function in debounce_meter.go and the trace blob schema in span_enricher.go in a follow-up comment.
